Sno. Planets Description
1 Mercury Mercury can refer to both a chemical element and a planet.
2 Venus Venus is the second planet from the Sun and is often called Earth's "sister planet"
3 Earth Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the only known planet to support life.
4 Mars Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun and is known for its reddish appearance in the night sky.
5 Jupiter Jupiter is the fifth planet from the Sun and is the largest planet in the solar system.
6 Saturn Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun and the second largest in the Solar System, after Jupiter.
7 Uranus Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun and the third largest in our solar system.
8 Neptune Neptune is the eighth and farthest planet from the Sun in our solar system.
9 Pluto Pluto is a dwarf planet located in the Kuiper Belt, beyond Neptune.
